_about: Data-source audit for the research lab (spec Part 3). One entry per source the site reads or the spec names. status: VERIFIED = the data itself was read and counted on the verified date; PARTIALLY VERIFIED = used in production or read through a secondary summary, depth not counted here; UNVERIFIED = described but not checked; UNAVAILABLE = refused or not reachable. A vendor's product page is never VERIFIED: only data counted is. research/registry.py checks every entry.

sources.access: public GitHub release CSV, no key
sources.coverage: read here: 2016-2025 complete (17,362-19,422 rows a season, weeks 1-22 incl. playoffs), 2026 weeks 1-5 (5,506 rows)
sources.update: weekly in season (the site's nightly ingest re-reads it)
sources.missing: a row exists only when a player recorded a stat: a receiver who played and saw no target is absent
sources.quality: totals per game only (no per-target yards); names change across seasons; ids stable
sources.license: not verified in this audit (check the nflverse-data repository's license and each upstream's terms)

sources.coverage: read here: 1999-2026, 7,548 games; every 2006-2025 game has a spread, total and referee; 2026: 107 of 272 games with lines so far
sources.ids: game_id, gsis, espn, pfr, pff, ftn
sources.missing: lines are one quote per game (not a time series, not per book); the referee is filled only after the game
sources.quality: spread_line, total_line, moneylines and their prices per game; roof, surface, temp, wind, coaches, QBs

sources.dataset: play-by-play, participation, snap counts, depth charts, injuries, FTN charting, PFR advanced, Next Gen Stats
sources.access: public GitHub release CSV, no key
sources.coverage: files present here: pbp 2021-2026, participation 2021-2025, snap counts 2021-2026, depth charts 2022-2026, injuries 2022-2026, FTN charting 2022-2026, PFR pass 2022-2025 / rush 2021-2026 / def 2021-2026, NGS passing/rushing/receiving (one file each)
sources.missing: FTN charting starts 2022; participation lags the season
sources.quality: row counts not taken in this audit (files present, sizes not checked)
sources.license: FTN charting carries its own attribution terms; not verified in this audit

sources.missing: schedules and rosters cached for four seasons only (none for 2026); transfer and availability data not in this file; the TARGET on an incompletion is often unnamed — share named, measured 2026-10-17: 2022 45%, 2023 38%, 2024 21%, 2025 78-84% by week, 2026 92% — so target counts before 2025 are short and not comparable across seasons; every rushing play names its runner
sources.quality: wide format by stat category; FBS and FCS mixed

sources.dataset: live and historical odds (games and player props)
sources.access: REST, paid key (already on the box; harvest_odds.py and engine/sources/oddshistory.py already speak the historical endpoints, with a cost estimate and a credit budget)
sources.coverage: per a search summary of the provider's own page (the page itself was not reachable from this sandbox): featured markets from 2020-06-06 (10-minute snapshots, 5-minute from 2022-09); additional markets incl. player props from 2023-05-03 (5-minute snapshots); historical on paid plans only, 10 credits per region per market per request. What the box has already harvested is counted by research/audit_box.py; already on the box from the site's own pulls: NFL props since 2025-09-07 (see SRC-OWN-LINES), so the 2025 and 2026 seasons need no historical purchase
sources.update: snapshots every 5-10 minutes (historical); live on demand
sources.ids: event id, bookmaker key, market key, outcome name/description
sources.missing: results/settlement not included (the site settles from box scores); suspended markets not represented as rows
sources.quality: snapshot = the provider's capture time (oddshistory stores the envelope's timestamp, not the requested one)
sources.license: plan terms not re-read in this audit

sources.coverage: third-party summaries only: closing-odds endpoint; historical depth by plan (48 hours free, up to 10 years on the top plan); whether historical PLAYER PROPS exist was not confirmed

sources.dataset: player props odds API with history
sources.coverage: the vendor's own FAQ (via search summary): historical pre-match and in-play odds incl. closing lines, alternate spreads/totals and player prop outcomes; scores/results on every plan; history reported on the Pro tier; prices in sources conflict
sources.missing: start dates per sport not found

sources.coverage: third-party listings describe a live pre-game props feed (one lists Underdog as the live source and a get_prop_history tool); no documented historical depth found
sources.missing: historical depth undocumented; UFC not listed

sources.dataset: the ledger: every pick with its claimed chance, the price posted, the close, the result; forecast_log hash-chained; bets_audit for every correction
sources.coverage: counted on the box 2026-10-17: about 28,300 settled picks across NFL, CFB, MLB, NHL, WNBA, UFC and the prediction-market books; forecast_log 32,366 sealed rows; the market fair is journaled only on the Edge book (NFL 246, MLB 631, CFB 5)
sources.missing: only the picks the site made (a selected sample, not every market)
sources.quality: prices are real observations at posting time; forecasts sealed before the game (forecast_log)
